title: Al-Mudawwana al-Kubra
author: sahnun
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Sahnun's record of the answers of Malik ibn Anas and his Medinan students, chiefly through Ibn al-Qasim, arranged by legal topic. It runs from purification and prayer through marriage, trade, inheritance and penalties, and preserves the reasoning of the early Maliki school in the words of its transmitters.
historicalContext: Sahnun compiled the work in Qayrawan from the teaching he had brought back from Medina. With the Muwatta it became the foundation of Maliki positive law in North Africa and al-Andalus, and later Maliki authors commented on it for centuries.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
